comparison.phase_denominator: valid dual first hit on designated thin object, nonconflicting center, at least one valid offset ray
comparison.m_rule: maximum of the two per-source absolute log-inverse p95 on training excluding the ten holdouts
comparison.priority: DepthSplat if condition passes, otherwise qualifying triangulation

caches.coordinates: Native pixel x,y have centers x+.5,y+.5. Full 512 px token maps or 518 px model-input maps are sampled at normalized grid 2*(coordinate+.5)/512-1, align_corners=False, border padding, after disk float16 cast. 518/14=37 patches along each dimension. An integer native crop of the full-resolution tensor equals its exact slice. No color jitter or flips.

config.architecture: E-L, 32/48/64 plain conv/ReLU U-Net; 16 observed input channels plus 16 projected full-frame OVG channels
config.crop_policy: One rod/gap anchor alternating, one multiview-valid anchor; choose a uniform crop containing the anchor.
config.depth_transform: Natural log inverse depth; Gaussian mixture NLL equally averages rod/gap/depth-boundary/remaining normal groups.
config.reductions: Depth1/depth2 SmoothL1 log inverse valid_dual, each weight 1 and beta .05. Order softplus weight .01 with hard clamp.

mask_M.gate: M concatenated to the gate head; original 32-channel appearance/geometry branch

config.mixed_precision: BF16 conv activations, FP32 mixture, reductions and Adam

observed_3b_pace.interpretation: 同期有 B 光学运行。这里给出 3b 日志相邻时间窗的实际步时。

dev005_f001.evidence: 原模块二日志提供资格与放置计数。用其 GT 候选缓存、中心标签和本轮已落盘同一 OVG EMA 深度核对局部仿射，不重跑光学。
dev005_f001.conclusion: dev005 f001 的 FP16 中心深度含 7,148 个零值，取倒数溢出并污染局部拟合；13,191 个合格候选的拟合逆深度全部非有限，故放置 0。

observations.training-079-3e07c2ea841832f9: 扇形杆大多留在前面、杆间背景推远，w 在密集根部随细杆切换；另一个宽缝框内虽有高 w，解码深度仍接近墙。
observations.training-071-2345d368c9e2cc12: E 将网格之间的背景推远并保留横竖杆，w 的高值顺着网格、格心低值连续，近焦色边比 OVG 平滑。
observations.training-112-428cfa39403fbda7: E 保留浅色横竖杆并把格间推到墙，w 呈窄高值条；远焦时 E 的杆比 OVG 更散。
observations.training-067-b04aa536b482f2e0: E 把缝推到接近 GT 的墙深并保留两条细杆，w 沿杆边切换，缝内基本保持低值，右上边缘有少量短起伏。
observations.training-102-8d47472c5dbcc0c8: E 将扇形细杆间推到墙深，根部一部分前层比 GT 更宽，w 在根部呈连续梯度并在细丝间反复切换。
observations.development-003-8c92e9e93c0ff003: E 把缝推远但仍呈块状，前层只在部分细杆连续保留，w 沿杆间歇跳变，远焦仍有窄亮线。
observations.development-004-403a5734469f072d: E 让蓝墙缝隙接近 GT，图中细粉杆多被选为后层，w 的高值集中在角落块状区域而非沿杆连续。
observations.development-005-35442efa18790d0a: E 将格间大片区域推到墙，杆上的 w 高值条基本连续，但解码前杆仍比 GT 偏远，近焦墙上的粉线比 OVG 更模糊。
observations.development-008-6feda700c49fc611: 鞋下缝隙有大片推远，部分家具或鞋底轮廓也落到后层，w 在鞋下大块切换并在小物体边界出现亮环，近焦鞋比参考更清楚。
